label: The name map compresses names
subgoals: Multiply the name length by the number of references
Add the token cost per reference and the one map line
Subtract to get the bytes saved

label: Total capacitance of a D_NET
subgoals: Scale every *CAP value by the C unit
Add ground and coupling entries of the net
Compare the sum with the total on the *D_NET line

label: Resistance along a parasitic path
subgoals: Scale every *RES value by the R unit
Build the resistor graph from the node pairs
Sum the resistances on the unique path from driver to sink
